class.name: IfcPcurve
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A pcurve is a curve which lies on the basis of a surface and is defined in the parameter space of that surface. The basis curve is a curve defined in the two-dimensional parametric space of a reference basis surface.
